import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a 2x2 subplot layout
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Detection Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Fraud distribution by transaction type
fraud_by_type = df.groupby('transaction_type')['is_fraud'].agg(['sum', 'count']).reset_index()
fraud_by_type['fraud_rate'] = fraud_by_type['sum'] / fraud_by_type['count'] * 100

ax1 = axes[0, 0]
x_pos = np.arange(len(fraud_by_type))
bars = ax1.bar(x_pos, fraud_by_type['fraud_rate'], color=['#ff6b6b', '#4ecdc4', '#45b7d1'])
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Fraud Rate by Transaction Type')
ax1.set_xticks(x_pos)
ax1.set_xticklabels(fraud_by_type['transaction_type'], rotation=0)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Add value labels on bars
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'{height:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Transaction amount distribution by fraud status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
fraud_amounts = df[df['is_fraud'] == 1]['amount']
legit_amounts = df[df['is_fraud'] == 0]['amount']

ax2.hist([legit_amounts, fraud_amounts], bins=30, label=['Legitimate', 'Fraud'], 
         color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Transaction Amount', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution')
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Fraud patterns by hour of day
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
hourly_fraud = df.groupby('hour_of_day')['is_fraud'].agg(['sum', 'count']).reset_index()
hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'] = hourly_fraud['sum'] / hourly_fraud['count'] * 100

ax3.plot(hourly_fraud['hour_of_day'], hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'], 
         marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=6, color='#e74c3c')
ax3.fill_between(hourly_fraud['hour_of_day'], hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'], 
                  alpha=0.3, color='#e74c3c')
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Fraud Rate by Hour of Day')
ax3.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. Average transaction amount by type and fraud status
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
avg_amount = df.groupby(['transaction_type', 'is_fraud'])['amount'].mean().reset_index()
pivot_data = avg_amount.pivot(index='transaction_type', columns='is_fraud', values='amount')

x_pos = np.arange(len(pivot_data))
width = 0.35

bars1 = ax4.bar(x_pos - width/2, pivot_data[0], width, label='Legitimate', 
                color='#2ecc71', edgecolor='black')
bars2 = ax4.bar(x_pos + width/2, pivot_data[1], width, label='Fraud', 
                color='#e74c3c', edgecolor='black')

ax4.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Average Amount', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Average Transaction Amount by Type and Fraud Status')
ax4.set_xticks(x_pos)
ax4.set_xticklabels(pivot_data.index, rotation=0)
ax4.legend()
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
